The webhook fires the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. The download link arrives in the buyer's inbox within 30 seconds. With this setup, creators can have a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery, giving them full data ownership and control over their sales.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of this payment infrastructure works by leveraging blockchain-based payments, such as USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. This allows creators to receive payments from international buyers without the need for intermediaries like Stripe or PayPal. This payment infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in South Asia and other regions where access to conventional payment platforms is restricted. The Components That Make It Work Together

The components that make this payment infrastructure work together include the frontend, built using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which provides a user-friendly interface for customers to purchase digital products. The backend logic, built using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, handles the payment processing and order storage. Additionally, the use of Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage ensures that creators can keep track of their sales and customer data securely. The NOWPayments integration enables automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, making it easy for creators to receive payments in various cryptocurrencies.

With these components in place, creators can have a fully operational online store that allows them to sell their digital products to a global audience.
